svg.aria-label: Actual Parkway paths moving from their geographic locations into separate tiles
svg.title: Parkway corridor to source shapes
svg.desc: Each path is a source GIS polyline. Grid north remains up. No rotation, smoothing, synthetic loops or independently stretched axes. The default overlay preserves relative length; unfolded tiles have individual uniform scales.
